content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire safety and building contracting for commercial facilities, not automated enforcement or tolling for governments and rental fleets."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online salvage vehicle auctions and yard storage, a vehicle remarketing business rather than violation or toll processing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale used-vehicle auctions and dealer floorplan financing, unlike Verra's enforcement cameras and toll and citation processing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Vehicle telematics hardware and fleet tracking software; shares fleet customers but does not run enforcement or tolling programs."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Payment processing software for merchants and institutions, not camera enforcement or toll and violation processing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Armored cash transport, ATM services and security logistics, a different business despite government and bank clients."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Fleet fuel cards, corporate payments and health benefits administration; fleet payments overlap in customers but not in service."}]}
